description: Rotating a model that is LIFTED for repositioning (reported 2026-07-30: 'when I reposition with L3 I can't rotate, the old position is still visible, and when I do rotate it's the ORIGINAL image that turns'). Two defects, both asserted here. (1) Every rotate input went to ghost_sprite — the ghost for the NEXT model — so R3+LB/RB spun the wrong thing and the lifted model dropped at its old facing; the reposition ghost now takes the rotation and the drop commits it into temp_rotations. (2) try_place_at never removed ghost_sprite after the last model went down, so a full-strength ghost sat frozen on the board at the pick-up point for the rest of the session (that was the 'original image' the player saw rotating, and the 'old position still visible' after the drop); it is now cleared, asserted by ghost_sprite being null both before and after the lift. The RB tap while R3 is HELD must also not cycle units — the rotate combo and the bumper-only unit switcher share LB/RB.
